answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 160673 Country: India Title: Are children entitled to claim their share in widow's pension? Question: A woman aged 75 is widow. She receives the pension of her husband. Does her step children also have right in the pension? Since the other wife is also not alive, the kids are aged 50, 38 and 47. Answer ID: 160673 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 908/854/M=8/1439) Pension is a contribution and gift from the government that the widow of a deceased person receives lifetime. Thus as per the government rule only the widow is entitled to receive it and the children of the deceased have no share in it. (Imdad al-Fatawa, vol. 4, p. 342, Kitab al-Faraidh; Mahmoodia, vol. 3, p. 193, Meerut) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
